payload_json.geometry: Chain-hop delivery: chaos nova originates at skeleton position, chains to nearby skeletons. Each chain hop generates a new nova at the next skeleton. Coverage scales with number of skeletons and their distribution across the battlefield. When cast without skeletons: nova originates at player's own position (self-damage mode). Area of effect at each hop is small blast radius.

dossier.anchor_quote: summon skeletons on the field and then directly connecting them by casting Dark Pact, chaining between your skeletons. The skill chains between skeletons when at least three are present.

payload_json.loop: Use Spell Totem or self-cast Summon Skeletons to populate the field with skeleton minions. Cast Dark Pact on clustered skeletons — the spell chains between them, sacrificing skeleton life to deal chaos damage in chaining novas. Skeletons die rapidly, requiring constant resummoning (two-button rotation). When no skeletons are present, Dark Pact damages the player's own life instead. Minion Life support gems on skeletons increase their life pool to amplify Dark Pact damage.

mapping.deviation_notes: chain + shadow(chaos) + drain lands the chaining sacrifice-nova, but the SIGNATURE is an INVERSION of the proxy pattern: skeletons are CONSUMABLE BATTERIES whose MAX LIFE is the ammo Dark Pact spends — Minion Life supports scale YOUR damage by inflating the battery. No engine lane represents 'proxy max-life as a consumable per-cast ammo pool'; the PROXY family models proxies that attack + are sustained, not consumed as fuel. Mapped as chain-nova + totem-battery-field + minion-life-consume note + hp_cost_scale no-skeleton fallback (native); captures the chain-chaos feel but loses the battery-inversion substrate. Docket filed (proxy-max-life-as-ammo, shared with animate-weapon + this batch's bladefall field-consume). mapping_json.fidelity_notes: chain + shadow(chaos) is the base geometry/element and lands; drain for the life-sacrifice register (poison is the alt chaos-DoT read, but the DOMINANT loop is a hit-nova that DRAINS minion life, not a stacking DoT — §7.2 dominant-loop wins). THE IDENTITY MISS: minions-as-CONSUMABLE-BATTERIES. Dark Pact's soul is an INVERSION of the normal proxy pattern — you don't direct skeletons to attack; you CONSUME their max-life as ammunition (Minion Life supports scale YOUR damage BY raising the battery capacity). The engine PROXY family + resource_economy models proxies that ATTACK and are sustained; it has no lane for 'proxy max-life is a consumable ammo pool the caster spends per cast.' Mapped as chain-nova + a totem-proxy field + minion-life-consume note + hp_cost_scale for the no-skeleton self-cost fallback (native), which captures the chain-chaos-nova + self-cost feel but LOSES the minion-as-battery consumption substrate. A Dark Pact player would notice their skeletons no longer FUNCTION as a spendable life-pool that Minion-Life gear inflates — the battery inversion is what made this kit unique. Docket candidate filed (proxy-max-life-as-consumable-ammo, shared family with animate-weapon batch-01 + bladefall-bladeblast field-resource-consume this batch). Engine chain DECAYS 0.7x/hop (arc-audit precedent): acceptable here since Dark Pact's chain PROPAGATES the sacrifice-nova rather than growing per-hop — but hop-count is capped at engine default (primary+3) vs PoE scaling to more skeletons; noted. PROXY_FISSION (one action -> many proxy interactions) + SACRIFICE_ASCENDANCY (life-as-fuel) are the closest capstones.
